note: Triennial election of the rural district council (ten electoral divisions), 1927: nominations received by W. J. Corner, clerk, 26 April 1927. No party labels printed. The council also had three co-opted members. Returned unopposed. John Geo. Gracey: no party label printed in 1927. At other elections he stood as Unionist (Kernan, Armagh County Council, 29 May 1930, printed 'U': Belfast News-Letter, 30 April 1930, p. 15 ("Apathy in Rural Districts"); withdrawals from the Lurgan Mail, 10 May 1930, p. 4 ("No Contests in Armagh: County Council Nominees Withdraw")).
